+import json
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_API_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions"
+OPENAI_MODEL = "gpt-4o-mini"
+
+
+def translate_text(text: str, target_language: str) -> str:
+    api_key = os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise RuntimeError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+
+    payload = {
+        "model": OPENAI_MODEL,
+        "messages": [
+            {"role": "system", "content": f"Translate the user's text to {target_language}. Return only the translation."},
+            {"role": "user", "content": text},
+        ],
+        "temperature": 0,
+    }
+    response = requests.post(
+        OPENAI_API_URL,
+        headers={
+            "Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}",
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        },
+        json=payload,
+        timeout=60,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    data = response.json()
+    return data["choices"][0]["message"]["content"].strip()
+
+
+def translate_dictionary_values(data: Dict[str, Any], target_language: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    translated = {}
+    for key, value in data.items():

+            translated[key] = translate_text(value, target_language)
+        elif isinstance(value, dict):
+            translated[key] = translate_dictionary_values(value, target_language)
+        else:
+            translated[key] = value
+    return translated
+
+

+    import argparse
+

+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":

+import os
+from html.parser import HTMLParser
+from typing import List
+
+from deepl import DeepLClient
+
+
+class _MarkupTranslator(HTMLParser):
+    def __init__(self, target_lang: str, client: DeepLClient):
+        super().__init__(convert_charrefs=False)
+        self.target_lang = target_lang
+        self.client = client
+        self.parts: List[str] = []
+        self._buffer: List[str] = []
+
+    def _flush_text(self) -> None:
+        if not self._buffer:
+            return
+        text = "".join(self._buffer)
+        self._buffer.clear()
+        if text.strip():
+            result = self.client.translate_text(text, target_lang=self.target_lang)
+            translated = result.text if hasattr(result, "text") else str(result)
+            self.parts.append(translated)
+        else:
+            self.parts.append(text)
+
+    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
+        self._flush_text()
+        attrs_str = "".join(f' {name}="{value}"' for name, value in attrs)
+        self.parts.append(f"<{tag}{attrs_str}>")
+
+    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
+        self._flush_text()
+        self.parts.append(f"</{tag}>")
+
+    def handle_startendtag(self, tag, attrs):
+        self._flush_text()
+        attrs_str = "".join(f' {name}="{value}"' for name, value in attrs)
+        self.parts.append(f"<{tag}{attrs_str}/>")
+
+    def handle_data(self, data):
+        self._buffer.append(data)
+
+    def handle_entityref(self, name):
+        self._buffer.append(f"&{name};")
+
+    def handle_charref(self, name):
+        self._buffer.append(f"&#{name};")
+
+    def handle_comment(self, data):
+        self._flush_text()
+        self.parts.append(f"<!--{data}-->")
+
+    def translate(self, markup: str) -> str:
+        self.feed(markup)
+        self._flush_text()
+        return "".join(self.parts)
+
+
+def translate_markup(markup: str, target_lang: str, auth_key: str | None = None) -> str:
+    key = auth_key or os.getenv("DEEPL_AUTH_KEY")
+    if not key:
+        raise ValueError("DEEPL_AUTH_KEY is required")
+    client = DeepLClient(auth_key=key)
+    return _MarkupTranslator(target_lang=target_lang, client=client).translate(markup)
*** End Patch

+import os
+import sys
+from typing import List
+
+import requests
+
+
+DEepl_API_URL = "https://api-free.deepl.com/v2/translate"
+
+
+def batch_translate_texts(texts: List[str], source_language: str, target_language: str) -> List[str]:
+    api_key = os.getenv("DEEPL_AUTH_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise RuntimeError("DEEPL_AUTH_KEY is required")
+
+    response = requests.post(
+        DEepl_API_URL,
+        data={
+            "auth_key": api_key,
+            "text": texts,
+            "source_lang": source_language,
+            "target_lang": target_language,
+        },
+        timeout=30,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    data = response.json()
+    translations = data.get("translations", [])
+    if len(translations) != len(texts):
+        raise RuntimeError("Unexpected number of translations returned by DeepL")
+    return [item["text"] for item in translations]
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    if len(sys.argv) < 4:
+        raise SystemExit(
+            "Usage: batch_translate.py <source_language> <target_language> <text1> [<text2> ...]"
+        )
+    source_language = sys.argv[1]
+    target_language = sys.argv[2]
+    texts = sys.argv[3:]
+    for translated in batch_translate_texts(texts, source_language, target_language):
+        print(translated)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+import os
+import sys
+from typing import List
+
+import requests
+
+
+DEepl_API_URL = "https://api-free.deepl.com/v2/translate"
+
+
+def batch_translate_texts(texts: List[str], source_language: str, target_language: str) -> List[str]:
+    api_key = os.getenv("DEEPL_AUTH_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise RuntimeError("DEEPL_AUTH_KEY is required")
+
+    response = requests.post(
+        DEepl_API_URL,
+        data={
+            "auth_key": api_key,
+            "text": texts,
+            "source_lang": source_language,
+            "target_lang": target_language,
+        },
+        timeout=30,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    data = response.json()
+    translations = data.get("translations", [])
+    if len(translations) != len(texts):
+        raise RuntimeError("Unexpected number of translations returned by DeepL")
+    return [item["text"] for item in translations]
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    if len(sys.argv) < 4:
+        raise SystemExit(
+            "Usage: batch_translate.py <source_language> <target_language> <text1> [<text2> ...]"
+        )
+    source_language = sys.argv[1]
+    target_language = sys.argv[2]
+    texts = sys.argv[3:]
+    for translated in batch_translate_texts(texts, source_language, target_language):
+        print(translated)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
